decision: The project must first freeze data identity, examination protocol, pass criteria, statistical unit, and claim boundary. No internal judge score may substitute for a recognized task-specific benchmark.

evidence_architecture.claim_boundary: Generator qualification only; no PM value, real-user effectiveness, or clinical safety claim.

evidence_architecture.primary_exam: ES-MemEval official QA, summarization, and dialogue-generation tasks
evidence_architecture.claim_boundary: Memory capability only; does not prove RS or learned PM selection value.
Causal value of the frozen learned selector under the frozen generator; no generator-agnostic claim without replication.
Personalization integrity only; not comprehensive clinical safety.

metric_policy.primary_pm_estimand: Same-state deployment-ITT contrasts on Quality, atomic Risk, and measured Cost.
metric_policy.function_role: Secondary mechanism and attribution evidence. A counted head needs nonzero reproducible source-aware contribution, but Function is not a sole subjective veto and need not be visible in every ON response.
metric_policy.uncertain_policy: UNCERTAIN remains its own category and cannot be forced into no-risk.
metric_policy.cost_definition: Actual generator input/output tokens, retrieval, retries, latency, and USD are reported separately. At least 10% lower input tokens versus fixed-high is the provisional cost floor; this does not override Quality or Risk.
metric_policy.margin_policy: No Quality/Risk or generator noninferiority margin may be chosen from observed formal outcomes. It must be anchored to scorer calibration, same-stack reference variation, and an outcome-blind practical-effect rationale.

statistical_units.ESC_Eval: role_card_or_dialogue, with clustering fixed before execution
statistical_units.ES_MemEval: user; 18 users; questions are repeated measurements and not independent samples
statistical_units.shared_source_rule: EvoEmo response and ES-MemEval are two tasks on the same 18 synthetic users, not independent population replications.

p0_gates.blocker: ES-MemEval final-paper 1209 rows are absent from public git history; choose an authoritative 1209 mapping or explicitly use the public-v1.0.0-1427 task.

Official commits, data shapes, and model revisions are pinned; ESC-Eval has an adapter-path defect and no dependency lock, while ESC-Judge lacks the paper-25 manifest, symmetric order implementation, and dependency lock. Local wrappers remain required.
ESC-RANK local calibration, same-stack reference, ESC-Judge position sensitivity, and human anchors are not executed.
No evidence-anchored Quality/Risk or generator NI margins are frozen.
ESC-Eval role sources overlap ESConv/ExTES; source, dialogue, and semantic overlap identities are not yet materialized.
Event taxonomy, dual review, adjudication, UNCERTAIN, and uncertainty reporting are frozen; packet/schema fixture is not implemented.

current_stress_test_policy.allowed_interpretation: Frozen opportunity-enriched treatment diagnostic after all arms are complete.
current_stress_test_policy.forbidden_interpretation: Formal three-track pass, generator qualification, or a final head verdict under the old Quality/Function rubric.
current_stress_test_policy.continuation_rule: The exact 48-call continuation may run only under its frozen identity after P0 execution prerequisites and a new explicit approval; no prompt, sample, seed, arm, or treatment change.
current_stress_test_policy.judging_rule: Do not perform final judging under the legacy composite or Function-veto logic.

execution_blocks_until_p0_complete: new development panel chosen from observed outcomes
